notes.title: Halloween Sale is Here! Here is some sweet stuff for you...
notes.content:
Ready to get scared... or not!

Halloween is the right time to enjoy some candies! Take care of your new friends in Fantasy Friends, and enjoy a lovely adventure among all the scary stuff around Halloween...

You really desserve a quiet place to chill out between two horror games sessions!

Fantasy Friends is now 50% OFF during the Halloween Steam Sale ! Grab it before it ends!

If you want to get even more sweeties... Please take a look at the new Fantasy Friends game, Fantasy Friends : Under The Sea, who just released last month and is currently 20% OFF !

notes.title: Happy Lunar New Year with Fantasy Friends !
notes.content:
This year, in 2021,  we celebrate the ox... Even if we don't have a proper ox in the game, we have many pets to take care of for the next year !

It's one of the main resolution for a Lunar New Year... Take care of each other ♥

The Game is now 50% off for a limited time! 
This offer is running until Feb 14th, so grab it until it ends, and discover your 12 new friends!
